title: Plan the status phase tokens
description: Like a prepared strategy-card secondary, the status phase's two token decisions can be planned while other players still act: where the command tokens gained at 81.5 go, and the arrangement of the redistribution that follows. The plan is a distribution of pools kept on this device for one round; when the engine asks, it is applied only if it fits exactly (same number of tokens, pools offered, fleet floor), automatically in Auto mode ('Answered from your plan') or with a one-click bar in Review mode, otherwise the question stays open with 'Needs review' and the plan as a suggestion. No engine, rules or hash change: the answers go through the usual choice and token-batch paths. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- FU.
